question: Show the average length of stay by diagnosis for inpatient encounters.
sql: SELECT conditions.DESCRIPTION AS diagnosis, AVG(DATEDIFF(encounters.STOP, encounters.START)) AS avg_los FROM encounters JOIN conditions ON encounters.ID = conditions.ENCOUNTER WHERE encounters.ENCOUNTERCLASS = 'inpatient' GROUP BY conditions.DESCRIPTION ORDER BY avg_los DESC;

question: What is the total claim cost and total payer coverage by encounter class?
sql: SELECT encounters.ENCOUNTERCLASS, SUM(encounters.TOTAL_CLAIM_COST) AS total_claim_cost, SUM(encounters.PAYER_COVERAGE) AS total_payer_coverage FROM encounters GROUP BY encounters.ENCOUNTERCLASS;

question: Count the number of patients grouped by gender and race.
sql: SELECT patients.GENDER, patients.RACE, COUNT(patients.ID) AS patient_count FROM patients GROUP BY patients.GENDER, patients.RACE;

question: List the top 5 most frequent diagnoses across all patient encounters.
sql: SELECT conditions.DESCRIPTION AS diagnosis, COUNT(*) AS diagnosis_count FROM conditions GROUP BY conditions.DESCRIPTION ORDER BY diagnosis_count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Calculate the total medication cost grouped by medication description.
sql: SELECT medications.DESCRIPTION, SUM(medications.TOTALCOST) AS total_medication_cost FROM medications GROUP BY medications.DESCRIPTION ORDER BY total_medication_cost DESC;

question: Retrieve patient encounters for read-only analytical review.
sql: SELECT encounters.ID, encounters.START, encounters.STOP, encounters.ENCOUNTERCLASS FROM encounters WHERE encounters.ENCOUNTERCLASS = 'inpatient';
